units.source_text: 两条狗乖乖地站在有蔷薇图案的绒毯上，彼此的头朝向相反的方向，用似乎睁大了瞳眸的润泽莹亮的眼睛，陶醉似的仰望着各自的主人。

en.t: The two dogs stood obediently on the velvet carpet patterned with roses, their heads turned in opposite directions, gazing up at their respective mistresses in rapture with moist, shining eyes that seemed to have opened wide.

units.source_text: 小宠犬的胸部波浪起伏。

en.t: The little pet dog's chest rose and fell in waves.

units.source_text: 它颈圈上的铃铛不响了，夫人的胸口也平静下来。

en.t: The bell on its collar stopped ringing, and the lady's breast also grew calm.

units.source_text: 不大一会儿，小宠犬的胸部又开始鼓动，这种颤动传染到夫人身心上来。

en.t: Before long, the little pet dog's chest began to throb again, and that trembling spread into the lady's body and mind.

units.source_text: 尽管这种鼓动是发自她分明看见却佯装不见的丑陋的东西，可不知怎的反而具有一种力量，促使她感到自己的生活是虚伪的。

en.t: Although this throbbing came from an ugly thing she clearly saw yet pretended not to see, somehow it possessed a force that made her feel her own life was false.

units.source_text: 然而，夫人暗自揣摩：难道这是由于活像美少年般秀丽的小姐的缘故吗？

en.t: Yet the lady wondered inwardly: could this be because of the young lady, as beautiful as a handsome boy?

units.source_text: “如此看来，这条狗才刚成年呢。”

en.t: "Seen this way, this dog has only just come of age."

units.source_text: （才刚成年？

en.t: Only just come of age?

units.source_text: 正是小姐自己啊！

en.t: That is the young lady herself!

units.source_text: 小姐一边说“才刚……”，肯定一边想起了母亲。

en.t: As the young lady said "only just...", she must have been thinking of her mother.

units.source_text: 还是小孩子呀。

en.t: She is still a child.

units.source_text: 地毯旧了。

en.t: The carpet has grown old.

units.source_text: 蔷薇。

en.t: Roses.

units.source_text: 让人想到女人之间的爱的眼神的蔷薇花哟！

en.t: O rose blossoms that call to mind the gaze of love between women!

units.source_text: 伪善的花哟！

en.t: O hypocritical flowers!

units.source_text: 无言的花哟！

en.t: O silent flowers!

units.source_text: 倘若是玉石，白天拿在手里呀！

en.t: If it is a jewel, hold it in your hand by day!

units.source_text: 夜间睡个好觉呀！

en.t: Sleep well at night!

units.source_text: 夜间睡个好觉呀！

en.t: Sleep well at night!

units.source_text: 老祖母边唱着这样的歌谣边哄孙儿睡觉的时候，心里在想些什么呢？

en.t: When the old grandmother sang such a song while lulling her grandchild to sleep, what was she thinking in her heart?

units.source_text: 女子不同于男子，女子长大后，女人之间依然喜欢手拉着手，喜欢一起睡眠。

en.t: Women are different from men; even after they grow up, women still like holding hands with one another and sleeping together.

units.source_text: 孩子。

en.t: A child.

units.source_text: 宠物。

en.t: A pet.

units.source_text: 还有所谓的才刚……

en.t: And the so-called only just...

units.source_text: 没错，小姐爱狗，像母亲那样。

en.t: Yes, the young lady loves dogs, like a mother.

units.source_text: 是处女的、狗的母亲，多美啊！

en.t: A virgin, and a mother to a dog, how beautiful!

units.source_text: 多么寂寞啊！

en.t: How lonely!

units.source_text: 夜间睡个好觉。

en.t: Sleep well at night.

units.source_text: 绒毯是新婚时买来的吗？

en.t: Was the velvet carpet bought at the time of her marriage?

units.source_text: 纵有煽动父母的妻子，我亦赶往矢作的市场购鞋去。

en.t: Even with a wife who incites my parents, I still hurry to the market at Yahagi to buy shoes.

units.source_text: 蔷薇红的乳头。

en.t: Rose-red nipples.

units.source_text: 蔷薇红的湿润，处女膜。

en.t: Rose-red moisture, the hymen.

units.source_text: 黄蔷薇。

en.t: Yellow roses.

units.source_text: 紫丁香花。

en.t: Lilac blossoms.

units.source_text: 柿子花——把我埋在美丽的国度里吧。

en.t: Persimmon blossoms, bury me in a beautiful land.

units.source_text: 埋葬我的时候，你会头一次把我当人看待吗？

en.t: When you bury me, will you for the first time treat me as a human being?

units.source_text: 莱德尔说过，处女膜是人的象征。

en.t: Reidel said that the hymen is the symbol of the human being.

units.source_text: 伊德尔梅涅人种的爱的模式。

en.t: The pattern of love among the Idelmenian race.

en.t: The menstruation of mice.

units.source_text: 施特拉斯曼的实验。

en.t: Strassmann's experiment.

units.source_text: 狗。

en.t: Dogs.

units.source_text: 认为人没有一处与动物不同的生物学说，为什么唯独在我身上竟是悲剧呢？

en.t: Why should the biological theory that humans differ from animals in no respect become a tragedy only in me?

units.source_text: 狗。

en.t: Dogs.

units.source_text: 不是庞贝的废墟。

en.t: Not the ruins of Pompeii.

units.source_text: 那是十八世纪呀。

en.t: That was the eighteenth century.

units.source_text: 斯帕兰札尼尝试做母狗的人工授精实验。

en.t: Spallanzani tried experiments in artificial insemination on female dogs.

en.t: Sodomy.

units.source_text: 丈夫说过：为什么要把所谓人造机器人做成人的模样呢？

en.t: Her husband had said: why make so-called robots in the shape of human beings?

units.source_text: 就是说，这也是人的一种感伤。

en.t: In other words, this too is a kind of human sentimentality.

units.source_text: 八犬传和克拉夫特-埃宾。

en.t: The Tale of the Eight Dogs and Krafft-Ebing.

units.source_text: 女人的鸡奸。

en.t: Women's sodomy.

units.source_text: 畜生，我肯定要向丈夫报仇。）

en.t: Damn it, I will surely take revenge on my husband.

units.source_text: 想到这里，夫人顿时生气勃勃，仿佛全然忘却了妇女应操守的礼仪，开始饶舌了。

en.t: At this thought, the lady suddenly came alive, and as if she had entirely forgotten the propriety a woman ought to observe, she began to chatter.
